description: This file implements a saturation-aware, priority-based dynamic rate limiter for API requests, utilizing a three-phase check to prevent over-allocation and ensure accurate tracking. It integrates with Redis for multi-instance safety and manages rate limits based on model capacity, user priority, and saturation levels.

classes.name: _PROXY_DynamicRateLimitHandlerV3
classes.description: A class implementing a saturation-aware, priority-based rate limiter that uses a three-phase check to prevent over-allocation, leveraging Redis for multi-instance safety, and managing rate limits based on model capacity and user priority.

methods.name: update_variables
methods.description: Updates the LLM router variable used for model info retrieval.

methods.name: _get_saturation_check_cache_ttl
methods.description: Returns the TTL for local cache when reading saturation values.

methods.name: _get_saturation_value_from_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves saturation value from cache with configurable TTL.

methods.name: _get_priority_weight
methods.description: Calculates the weight for a given priority based on reservation settings.

methods.name: _get_priority_from_user_api_key_dict
methods.description: Extracts priority from user API key metadata, checking team metadata first.

methods.name: _normalize_priority_weights
methods.description: Normalizes priority weights if their sum exceeds 1.0, converting absolute values to percentages.

methods.name: _get_priority_allocation
methods.description: Determines the priority weight and pool key for a given model and priority.

methods.name: _check_model_saturation
methods.description: Checks current saturation levels for a model by querying Redis counters for RPM and TPM.

methods.name: _create_priority_based_descriptors
methods.description: Creates rate limit descriptors with normalized priority weights for a model and user priority.

methods.name: _create_model_tracking_descriptor
methods.description: Creates a descriptor for tracking overall model usage with optional high limit multiplier.

methods.name: _check_rate_limits
methods.description: Performs a three-phase rate limit check to prevent partial counter increments, enforcing model capacity and priority limits based on saturation.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Main pre-call hook that performs saturation check and rate limit enforcement in three phases.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to add rate limit headers and update token usage counters after successful API calls.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Logs token usage after successful API calls, incrementing counters for model-wide and priority-specific tracking.
